name: muniee
description: muniee — a collection of small, sharp, client-side web apps. Served by a Cloudflare Worker with host-based routing.

scripts.build:apps: npm run build:sweep && npm run build:timeformats && npm run build:timezones && npm run build:cron
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build:apps && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @muniee/sweep && npm run typecheck -w @muniee/timeformats && npm run typecheck -w @muniee/timezones && npm run typecheck -w @muniee/cron && npm run typecheck -w @muniee/worker
